Create a synthetic content workspace and workspace permission, then create distinct synthetic groups. At API 62.0 and 67.0, create ContentWorkspaceMember records with a workspace and group, comparing omission of ContentWorkspacePermissionId with a valid populated permission. Create distinct FieldServiceMobileSettings for each trial; similarly compare MobileSettingsAssignment records with and without a valid ProfileId, using different profiles at the two API versions to avoid duplicate assignments. These observations cover creation boundaries, not ordering.
